issues.what: the bones are melted and smeared: the spine is a flat lumpy ribbon, ribs and limbs fuse into a blob, no skull reads; -a has crisp separate vertebrae, ribs, skull and long limb bones. The skeleton is static, so this is not settled motion blur
issues.fix: rebuild a clean, articulated skeleton with distinct skull, ribs and limb bones, sitting on the rock with contact shadows and algae tangled through it

issues.where: the shelf algae and shallow water, left half and centre
issues.what: the algae is a flat orange texture laid over rock and water like a sheet, with no strands and no volume; in -a it is loose rust-gold filaments lying in clear shallow water over pale travertine
issues.fix: replace the sheet with separate filamentous strands that cast small shadows, with clear shallow water and pale rock visible between them

issues.where: the drop-off from the shelf into the deep water
issues.what: the underwater cliff wall dropping into dark blue depth is missing; the edge is a shallow lip over flat blue water, so the scale of the drop and the clarity of the water are gone
issues.fix: show the submerged rock wall falling away beneath the shelf edge into blue-black depth, seen through clear water

issues.where: the far cliffs, sky and horizon
issues.what: the cliffs are closer and cropped at the top with no sky; the haze is a flat wall standing on a ruler-straight waterline; -a shows distant sunlit cliffs under a pale sky with low mist lying on the water
issues.fix: push the cliffs back, show a strip of sky, and let the mist lie low and thin on the water with a soft, broken edge

issues.what: the warm cliff reflections and the concentric ripple rings are missing; the water is choppy blue with faint orange streaks, and the left shallows reflect strong orange like a light source
issues.fix: calm the water to a mirror with golden cliff reflections and faint ripple rings, and cut the orange glare on the left shallows

issues.what: everything is sharp from foreground to cliffs; -a has a shallow focus with soft background, which carries its macro scale
issues.fix: add lens depth of field so the far shore and cliffs fall soft

issues.what: small white fin-like specks stand on the horizon that are not in -a

issues.where: the haze at the foot of the cliffs
issues.what: the mist is a flat grey band with hard, grainy top and bottom edges, over a brown strip at the waterline; in -a it is thin soft vapour drifting over the water and the scree shore
issues.fix: make the mist soft and uneven, thinning upward, with no hard edges or noise, and remove the brown strip

issues.what: the necks are darker grey-brown with stripes and taper to horn-like points, and the left one bends sharply to the right; in -a they are pale cream, smooth, rim-lit by the low sun, with rounded heads and upright necks
issues.fix: match the pale cream skin, warm rim light, rounded heads and upright neck pose of -a

issues.what: the cliffs fill the top of the frame and come right down to the water, with no sky; the scree slope and shore on the right and the low gravel beach are missing, so the lake reads smaller
issues.fix: push the cliffs back and restore the scree slope and the strip of shore under them

issues.where: the reflections in the lower half
issues.what: the cliff reflections are vertical stretched streaks in stepped columns, with no ripple breakup; in -a they are broken golden patches on the ripples
issues.fix: break the reflections with the ripple pattern into soft horizontal gold patches

issues.where: the water surface and the fins
issues.what: the ripples are evenly spaced parallel bands and the fins are small, uniform and lit bright white; in -a the rings spread from the swell and the fins are lit warm with splash at their bases
issues.fix: let the rings spread from the disturbance, vary fin sizes, and light them warm with small splash where they cut the water
